description: This PHP class 'ImportCacheFiles' provides static methods to manage filenames and paths for various cache files used during data import processes in SuiteCRM, including retrieval of import directory, filename generation, and cache cleanup.

classes.name: ImportCacheFiles
classes.description: A static utility class for managing cache file names and paths related to import functionality in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getImportDir
methods.description: Returns the import directory URL used for uploading and managing import files.

methods.name: convertFileNameToUrl
methods.description: Converts a filesystem file path into a downloadable URL link for the import error files.

methods.name: _createFileName
methods.description: Private method that builds a filename for cache files based on type and current user ID.

methods.name: ensureWritable
methods.description: Checks whether all cache files and directories are writable or can be created.

methods.name: getDuplicateFileName
methods.description: Gets the filename used for storing duplicate records during import.

methods.name: getDuplicateFileDisplayName
methods.description: Gets the filename for displaying duplicate records in the UI.

methods.name: getErrorFileName
methods.description: Retrieves the filename for storing error logs from import process.

methods.name: getErrorRecordsFileName
methods.description: Retrieves the filename for error records during import.

methods.name: getErrorRecordsWithoutErrorFileName
methods.description: Gets the filename for error records without associated error logs.

methods.name: getStatusFileName
methods.description: Gets the filename for caching import status.

methods.name: clearCacheFiles
methods.description: Deletes all CSV cache files in the import directory.
